english_explanations: The science of ancient life through fossil animals and plants.

chinese_translations.example: Paleontology traces the ancestry of the elephants.

english_explanations: A scientist who studies the biology of extinct organisms.

chinese_translations.example: The paleobiologist dated the mammoth bones with isotopes.

english_explanations: The earliest period of the Mesozoic era, about 252 to 201 million years ago.

chinese_translations.example: The first dinosaurs appeared in the Triassic.

english_explanations: The middle period of the Mesozoic era, about 201 to 145 million years ago.

chinese_translations.example: Giant sauropods dominated the Jurassic landscape.

english_explanations: The last period of the Mesozoic era, ending 66 million years ago in a mass extinction.

chinese_translations.example: The Cretaceous ended with the dinosaurs' extinction.

english_explanations: The epoch of repeated ice ages, from about 2.6 million to 11,700 years ago.

chinese_translations.example: Mammoths roamed the Pleistocene steppe.

english_explanations: A division of geological time; a distinctive period in history.

chinese_translations.example: geological epochs
The death of the emperor marked the end of an epoch in the country's history.
The death of the emperor marked the end of an epoch in the country's history.

english_explanations: Periods of a thousand years (singular: millennium).

chinese_translations.example: The tortoises colonized the islands millennia ago.
the second millennium AD

english_explanations: A sequence of descendants traced from a common ancestor.

chinese_translations.example: DNA shows the finches share one lineage.
DNA shows the finches share one lineage.
DNA shows the finches share one lineage.

english_explanations: A population within a species that differs in genetics or appearance.

chinese_translations.example: Each island hosts its own subspecies of the lizard.

english_explanations: An animal lacking a backbone, such as an insect or worm.

chinese_translations.example: Owls feed on invertebrates after dark.

english_explanations: An animal with a backbone, including fish, birds, and mammals.

chinese_translations.example: Fish, birds and mammals are all vertebrates.

english_explanations: To dig out something buried, especially archaeological remains.

chinese_translations.example: The site has been excavated by archaeologists.
The body was discovered when builders excavated the area.

english_explanations: To find by digging; to reveal something hidden.

chinese_translations.example: to unearth buried treasures
Speleologists unearthed cave-bear skulls in the alpine cave.

english_explanations: A dense metal rare on the surface, concentrated by asteroid impacts.

chinese_translations.example: The iridium layer marks the dinosaurs' demise.

english_explanations: A naturally magnetic iron ore; birds may use it to sense direction.

chinese_translations.example: Beak cells contain magnetite, a built-in compass.

english_explanations: A form of an element with a different atomic weight, used to date and trace remains.

chinese_translations.example: radioactive isotopes

english_explanations: An instrument that analyses light or mass to identify substances.

chinese_translations.example: The team ran the samples through a mass spectrometer.

english_explanations: The destruction or killing of a large proportion of a group.

chinese_translations.example: Otters suffered decimation during the fur-trade years.
Otters suffered decimation during the fur-trade years.

english_explanations: Killing far beyond what is sustainable; a proposed cause of megafaunal extinction.

chinese_translations.example: Human overkill may explain the mammoths' disappearance.

english_explanations: To cause severe and lasting damage to something.

chinese_translations.example: The bomb devastated much of the old part of the city.
The bomb devastated much of the old part of the city.

english_explanations: To return a species, often captive-bred, to its former wild habitat.

chinese_translations.example: Otters were reintroduced to the river after decades of absence.
Otters were reintroduced to the river after decades of absence.

english_explanations: Tourism to natural areas designed to support conservation.

chinese_translations.example: Ecotourism now funds the monkey reserve.

english_explanations: A person who works to protect wildlife and habitats.

chinese_translations.example: Conservationists campaigned to save the thylacine, but too late.
Conservationists campaigned to save the thylacine, but too late.

english_explanations: (of animals) born and raised in captivity, often for release into the wild.

chinese_translations.example: Captive-bred ferrets learned to hunt before release.

english_explanations: The state of a species having no living members.

chinese_translations.example: a tribe threatened with extinction/in danger of extinction
a tribe threatened with extinction/in danger of extinction
